topic: Activating a Phone Plan and eSIM at the Carrier Store

script.title: AT THE PHONE STORE
script.scene_zh: 電信門市 · 啟用 eSIM
script.story_hook: Fresh in town, and the phone is silent.
script.intro_zh: 初到異地，手機完全沒有訊號。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to a carrier store visit. Listen for plan and eSIM words.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到電信門市這一集。留意方案、轉號與 eSIM 的實用說法。
script.outro: And that's a number saved across an ocean. Listen again and repeat along.
script.outro_zh: 一通跨海保號就此完成。再聽一遍，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line out loud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們逐句大聲跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a middle-aged man in his late forties with short salt-and-pepper hair, thin wire glasses, a navy blue windbreaker jacket over a light grey polo shirt, a canvas shoulder bag, and a stocky build
script.char_b_description: a young woman in her early twenties with long straight auburn hair in a high ponytail, a black carrier-store polo vest, a laminated name badge, small silver earrings, and a slim build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, sorry to bother you, do you have a minute?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈsɑɹi tə ˈbɑðɚ ju du ju hæv ə ˈmɪnət/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，不好意思打擾一下，請問你有空嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! Are you new around here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs ɑɹ ju nu əˈɹaʊnd hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 當然！你是剛來這附近的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Very new, actually. I just landed last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /vɛɹi nu ˈæktʃuəli aɪ dʒʌst ˈlændəd læst wik/
dialogue.zh: 非常新，我上週才剛下飛機落地。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome! How's America treating you so far?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm haʊz əˈmɛɹɪkə ˈtɹitɪŋ ju soʊ fɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎！到目前為止，這裡的生活感覺如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, busy, but the food trucks are worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈbizi bət ðə fuːd tɹɑks ɑɹ wɝθ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，忙得很，但街邊的餐車值得回味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Totally true. So what brings you in today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtoʊɾəli tru soʊ wət bɹɪŋz ju ɪn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 說得太對了。那今天想辦點什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I really need a phone plan that works today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɹiəli nid ə foʊn plæn ðət wɝks təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我真的需要一個今天就能上手的手機方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect timing. Do you have your passport with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ du ju hæv jɔɹ ˈpæspɔɹt wɪð ju/
dialogue.zh: 時間剛剛好。你的護照有帶來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right here, um, it was buried under my map.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt hɪɹ ʌm ɪt wəz ˈbɛɹid ˈʌndɚ maɪ mæp/
dialogue.zh: 就在這兒，嗯，它藏在我的紙本地圖底下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Haha, paper maps, classic. Okay, I'll scan this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑhɑ ˈpeɪpɚ mæps ˈklæsɪk oʊˈkeɪ aɪl skæn ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，紙本地圖，太經典了。好，我來掃描。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that everything you need to start?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðət ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ju nid tu stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 開始辦理只要這本護照就夠了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That plus a quick form, all in English though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt plʌs ə kwɪk fɔɹm ɔl ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 再加上這張短表格，不過表格全是英文的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No problem, my English survives daily life just fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm maɪ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ sɚˈvaɪvz ˈdeɪli laɪf dʒʌst faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我的英文應付日常生活還挺順。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice! So, prepaid or a monthly plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs soʊ ˈpɹiˌpeɪd ɔɹ ə ˈmʌnθli plæn/
dialogue.zh: 很好！那要預付式的，還是月租方案？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, I don't know the difference yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəstli aɪ doʊnt noʊ ðə ˈdɪfɹəns jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我還分不太清楚兩者的差別。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. Prepaid means paying before you use it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɹ θɪŋ ˈpɹiˌpeɪd minz ˈpeɪɪŋ bɪˈfɔɹ ju juz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 交給我。預付就是先付錢、再開始使用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And a monthly plan gives me more data, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ə ˈmʌnθli plæn ɡivz mi mɔɹ ˈdeɪɾə ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那月租方案是資料量更多，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually, yes, plus it can hold your old number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli jɛs plʌs ɪt kən hoʊld jɔɹ oʊld ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 通常是，而且它還保得住你的舊門號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, wait, can I keep my travel eSIM number?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ weɪt kən aɪ kip maɪ ˈtɹævəl ˈiːsɪm ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，等等，我那張旅行 eSIM 的號碼留得下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can port it over, if it's still active.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kən pɔɹt ɪt ˈoʊvɚ ɪf ɪts stɪl ˈæktɪv/
dialogue.zh: 只要那張卡還在啟用狀態，我們就能把號碼轉過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's active, but only two more days, uh oh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈæktɪv bət ˈoʊnli tu mɔɹ deɪz ʌ oʊ/
dialogue.zh: 它還在啟用，但只剩兩天了，糟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's port it right now, no time to waste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛts pɔɹt ɪt ɹaɪt naʊ noʊ taɪm tu weɪst/
dialogue.zh: 那我們馬上辦轉號，一分一秒都不能浪費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does porting work, do I call my old company?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dʌz ˈpɔɹtɪŋ wɝk du aɪ kɔl maɪ oʊld ˈkʌmpəni/
dialogue.zh: 轉號要怎麼運作？我得打電話給原本的業者嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you just give me the number and account pin.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ju dʒʌst ɡɪv mi ðə ˈnʌmbɚ ænd əˈkaʊnt pɪn/
dialogue.zh: 不用，你只要給我號碼和帳號的 PIN 碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pin... um, I set it as nine-one-one, oops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɪn ʌm aɪ sɛt ɪt æz naɪn wʌn wʌn ups/
dialogue.zh: PIN 碼⋯⋯嗯，我當初設的是 9-1-1，有點糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, funny, but let's change that on the new plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈfʌni bət lɛts tʃeɪndʒ ðæt ɑn ðə nu plæn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，真有趣，不過新方案我們要換一組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Definitely. Now, what does a good plan cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɛfənətli naʊ wət dʌz ə ɡʊd plæn kɔst/
dialogue.zh: 那是當然。那一個好一點的方案多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty a month for unlimited data and hotspot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪkti ə mʌnθ fɚ ʌnˈlɪməɾɪd ˈdeɪɾə ænd ˈhɑtsˌpɑt/
dialogue.zh: 一個月六十塊，包含無限流量和熱點共享。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hotspot meaning my phone becomes wifi for my laptop?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑtsˌpɑt ˈminɪŋ maɪ foʊn bɪˈkʌmz ˈwaɪfaɪ fɚ maɪ ˈlæptɑp/
dialogue.zh: 熱點共享是指手機變成筆電的網路嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, six devices at once on that tier.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli sɪks dɪˈvaɪsəz æt wʌns ɑn ðæt tɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 完全正確，那個價位可以同時連六台設備。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My laptop is old, will it even take the plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlæptɑp ɪz oʊld wɪl ɪt ˈivən teɪk ðə plæn/
dialogue.zh: 我的筆電很舊了，撐得住這個方案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Probably! eSIM lives in the phone, everything shares.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɹɑbəbli ˈiːsɪm lɪvz ɪn ðə foʊn ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ʃɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 應該可以！eSIM 住在手機裡，大夥都能共用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes sense, my old laptop eats batteries anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt meɪks sɛns maɪ oʊld ˈlæptɑp its ˈbætɹiz ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這樣就通了，我那舊筆電本來也很吃電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, every old laptop's secret hobby. Ready to choose?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈɛvɹi oʊld ˈlæptɑps ˈsikɹɪt ˈhɑbi ˈɹɛdi tu tʃuz/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，每台舊筆電都有的祕密嗜好。準備選了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the sixty plan, and port my old number.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ˈsɪkti plæn ænd pɔɹt maɪ oʊld ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 選好了，六十塊那個方案，再把舊門號轉過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great pick. Now the form, please print your full name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt pɪk naʊ ðə fɔɹm pliz prɪnt jɔɹ fʊl neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 好選擇。接著是表格，請工整寫下你的全名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a second, um, my name has a tricky part.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə ˈsɛkənd ʌm maɪ neɪm hæz ə ˈtɹɪki pɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 稍等一下，嗯，我的名字有點小麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh? Chinese names trip our forms up sometimes.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ tʃaɪˈniz neɪmz trɪp ɑɹ fɔɹmz ʌp ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 噢？中文名字常常會卡住我們的表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine is family name first, then my given name.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪnz ˈfæməli neɪm fɝst ðɛn maɪ ˈɡɪvən neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 我的姓名順序是先寫姓氏，再寫名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So here, last name means family name, perfect match.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hɪɹ læst neɪm minz ˈfæməli neɪm ˈpɝfɪkt mætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 所以這裡的 last name 指的就是姓氏，剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the middle box, can it stay blank?
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ðə ˈmɪdəl bɑks kən ɪt steɪ blæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 那中間這一格，可以留空嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blank is fine, just match your passport exactly.
dialogue.phonetic: /blæŋk ɪz faɪn dʒʌst mætʃ jɔɹ ˈpæspɔɹt ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 留空沒問題，只要和護照上的寫法一致就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, the passport prints my name all in capitals.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðə ˈpæspɔɹt prɪnts maɪ neɪm ɔl ɪn ˈkæpəɾəlz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，護照上的名字全部是大寫字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Copy it that way, computers love matching caps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑpi ɪt ðæt weɪ kəmˈpjutɚz lʌv ˈmætʃɪŋ kæps/
dialogue.zh: 就照那樣寫，電腦最喜歡一模一樣的格式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. So when does the port actually land?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn soʊ wɛn dʌz ðə pɔɹt ˈæktʃuəli lænd/
dialogue.zh: 寫好了。那這個轉號大概什麼時候生效？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually same day, your old line dies by evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli seɪm deɪ jɔɹ oʊld laɪn daɪz baɪ ˈivnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 通常當天完成，舊門號傍晚就會停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, both lines stay alive until the switch?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt boʊθ laɪnz steɪ əˈlaɪv ʌnˈtɪl ðə swɪtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，切換之前，兩個號碼都還活著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that way no texts get lost mid-air.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt weɪ noʊ tɛksts ɡɛt lɑst mɪdˈɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 對，這樣簡訊就不會丟失在半空中。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, my number followed me across an ocean.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ maɪ ˈnʌmbɚ ˈfɑloʊd mi əˈkɹɔs ən ˈoʊʃən/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這個號碼跟著我跨越了一整個海洋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the magic of porting, seriously.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈmædʒɪk əv ˈpɔɹtɪŋ ˈsɪɹiəsli/
dialogue.zh: 這就是轉號的魔法，說真的，很厲害吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So when do I actually get the new eSIM?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛn du aɪ ˈæktʃuəli ɡɛt ðə nu ˈiːsɪm/
dialogue.zh: 那我什麼時候能拿到新的 eSIM 呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's digital! Scan this QR code when we're done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈdɪdʒɪtəl skæn ðɪs ˌkju ˈɑɹ koʊd wɛn wɪɹ dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 它是數位版的！辦完掃這個 QR 條碼就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No little plastic card to mail me at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈlɪɾəl ˈplæstɪk kɑɹd tu meɪl mi ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 完全不用寄小塑膠卡給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing mailed, it lands in your phone in minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ meɪld ɪt lændz ɪn jɔɹ foʊn ɪn ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 什麼都不用寄，幾分鐘內就裝進你的手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing. And the plan starts today too, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmæzɪŋ ænd ðə plæn stɑɹts təˈdeɪ tu ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太神奇了。方案也是今天馬上開始，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Starts the second the QR scan finishes, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑɹts ðə ˈsɛkənd ðə ˌkju ˈɑɹ skæn ˈfɪnɪʃəz jɛs/
dialogue.zh: QR 掃描一結束，那一秒就正式生效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This was way easier than I expected.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌz weɪ ˈisɪɚ ðæn aɪ ɪkˈspɛktɪd/
dialogue.zh: 整個過程比我預期的簡單太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We like first visits to feel like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi laɪk fɝst ˈvɪzəts tu fil laɪk ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 我們就希望第一次進門的客人都這麼覺得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, my phone is about to feel brand new.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju maɪ foʊn ɪz əˈbaʊt tu fil brænd nu/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，我的手機馬上就有煥然一新的感覺了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Congrats! Welcome to the country... and hold still!
dialogue.phonetic: /kənˈɡɹæts ˈwɛlkəm tə ðə ˈkʌntri ænd hoʊld stɪl/
dialogue.zh: 恭喜，歡迎來到美國⋯⋯別動，正在掃描！

script.youtube_title: 【剛到美國辦手機門號📱】「這個號碼跟著我跨了海」預付・轉號・掃QR啟用一次聽齊🛂📶🎧｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Phone Plan and eSIM
script.youtube_title_en: "Followed Me Across an Ocean" — Getting a Phone Plan and eSIM as a Newcomer
script.youtube_description:
「這個號碼跟著我跨越了一整個海洋」——剛落地美國，第一件事就是走進電信門市，辦一個今天就能用的手機方案，順便把旅行 eSIM 的舊門號救回來。這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在門市櫃檯前。

你會聽到：打招呼請店員空下來開辦的客套話；prepaid 預付和月租方案的差別、無限流量與熱點共享的問法；把舊門號整條 port 過來的關鍵句，還有 PIN 碼的小插曲；中文姓名在全英文表格上怎麼寫才不會出錯；最後掃 QR 條碼當場啟用 eSIM 的完整流程。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與十個詞以內的短句，反覆出現的是美國人每天的真實語感：um、oh、so、right。聽完你就會用：What brings you in today?、Do you have your passport with you?、Can I keep my travel eSIM number?、It's still active。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱並打開小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"My number followed me across an ocean" — one week after landing in the US, you walk into a carrier store needing a phone plan that works today, and you want to keep the number from your travel eSIM. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right at the counter.

You will hear: polite small talk to get a rep's time; prepaid vs monthly plans, unlimited data and hotspot questions; the key lines for porting an old number, plus a PIN-code mishap; filling an English-only form when your name order runs the other way; and activating the eSIM by scanning a QR code on the spot.

Everything stays at A2 level, ten words or fewer per line, with the fillers Americans really use: um, oh, so, right. By the end you'll own lines like What brings you in today?, Can I keep my travel eSIM number? and It's still active.

Chapter 4 is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

📌 影片簡介：
剛到美國，手機卻還是一塊磚頭，你走進電信門市，開口的第一句該怎麼說？預付和月租到底差在哪？旅行 eSIM 的舊門號，真的救得回來嗎？

這一集帶大家走進社區電信門市，從出示護照、比較方案、轉帶舊門號、填寫英文表格，一路聽到掃 QR 條碼啟用 eSIM，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🛂 開場句：I really need a phone plan that works today.
📶 問方案：Nice! So, prepaid or a monthly plan?
🔁 保號句：Oh, wait, can I keep my travel eSIM number?
📝 填表句：Mine is family name first, then my given name.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、oh、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟門市之旅走一趟，下次自己坐進櫃檯對面，話就會自己開口。
